text:
maya: Quick async rollup for the bridge canary (2% us-east). Post 1-line: what you did / blocker / next step.

oliver: Noticed a small p50 spike right after deployment (~20:15 UTC). p50 ~40ms -> ~220ms for ~6m then back to baseline. No 5xx. I'll keep tailing.

sasha: Found a potential kv-cache warm race when using quantized runtime path. Repro locally. Opening a tiny PR to add a readiness gate: https://git.redwood/pr/2981. Need runtime +1.

priyanka: Verified flag split for ff:affinity-slice - slice 13 = 2% traffic. Running E2E OTP and user flow smoke now (ETA ~8m).

dmitri: Oncall: saw repeated "kv-cache-version-mismatch" errors during the initial warm. Rolled one pod and relaunched warmers; errors dropped.

maya: Can you paste a couple of log lines, @dmitri? Holding any ramp until cache warmers stable 30m.

dmitri: Snippet: ```2026-11-03T20:12:34Z model-serve ERROR kv-cache-version-mismatch key=usr_abc shard=3 ttl_actual=0 ttl_expected=3600``` Looks like init job didn't finish before traffic.

sasha: Matches my trace. I'll add readiness and a short backoff to my PR. Pinging @runtime-team for review.

oliver: Left a short note in the rollout doc about the latency spike, will keep monitoring traces and p95.

priyanka: Biz asked to keep full ramp on hold until EOD PST for one more perf sweep.

maya: Ops plan: keep canary at 2% for 45m. If no new errors and warmers stable for 30m we can cut to 10% (pending biz ok).

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: slice 13 created @3123456789 (2% traffic) 1. image: inference:v7-canary.

oliver: I'm available to dig deeper for ~30m. Will post any anomalies.

priyanka: E2E smoke: green. No errors, median latency unchanged. Posting screenshot: https://screenshot.redwood/smoke-312345 (green).

dmitri: I'll restart warmers if mismatch >3/min. Monitoring alerts wired up.

sasha: Runtime +1 received, PTAL at PR comments. I'll update readiness behavior.

oliver: +1 on the readiness approach, small comment about adding the cache key to debug logs.

maya: Good. Hold ramp until 30m stability and biz signoff. If stable, bump to 10% tomorrow morning PST.

deploy-bot: canary-update: manual bump to 5% by maya @3123456900.
